probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q(p) = p^H Z p with respect to the corresponding precoder p, where the quadratic form is based on a transmission line impedance of a transmission line between a signal source and the antenna array __and is computed as a function of the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, and a signal source impedance__; receiving a signal from the signal source; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array __and wherein the transformation is performed such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is computed and verified to be equal before applying the transformed precoder to the signal__.

3. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array __and wherein the matching network parameters are incorporated into the impedance calculation__.

4. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line __and wherein these parameters are combined to define the quadratic form as Q(p) = p^H Z(Z_0, Z_A, l) p where Z_0 is the signal source impedance, Z_A is the antenna array impedance, and l is the transmission line length__.

5. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied __such that the scaled precoder p' = p / sqrt(Q(p)) results in equal transmit power for all transformed precoders__.

6. (Previously presented) The method according to claim 5, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form.

7. (Previously presented) The method according to claim 5, further comprising transmitting a scaling factor used for the scaling.

8. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix T such that the resulting set of transformed precoders each satisfy the condition that Q(T·p_i) = Q(T·p_j) for all precoders p_i and p_j in the plurality of precoders __and such that each transformed precoder maps to antenna patterns having equal transmit power__.

9. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 8, wherein the transformation matrix is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array __and is computed such that T diagonalizes or normalizes the quadratic form across all precoders in the codebook__.

10. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders __by ensuring that the quadratic form Q(p) evaluated for each transformed precoder yields an identical value__.

11. (Previously presented) The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.

12. (Previously presented) The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation.

13. (Previously presented) The method according to claim 12, further comprising: receiving a precoded signal including reference symbols; estimating channels for the reference symbols; estimating a channel for the data symbols by taking an inner product of a conjugate of a data symbol precoder and the reference symbol channel estimates; and demodulating received data symbols based on the estimated channel.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: an antenna array; a transceiver coupled to the antenna array; a signal source coupled to the transceiver; a transmission line coupled between the signal source and the antenna array, the transmission line having a transmission line impedance; a memory to store a codebook including a plurality of precoders; and a controller coupled to the transceiver and the memory, the controller configured to: receive a plurality of precoders from the codebook, transform each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q(p) = p^H Z p with respect to the corresponding precoder p, where the quadratic form is based on the transmission line impedance __and is computed as a function of the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, and a signal source impedance__, receive a signal from the signal source, and apply a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel, wherein the transceiver transmits the precoded signal.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the quadratic form is also based on at least one selected from an impedance matrix of the antenna array, a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line __and wherein the controller computes and verifies that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal before transmission__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied __such that the scaled precoder p' = p / sqrt(Q(p)) results in equal transmit power for all transformed precoders__.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 16, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form __and wherein the controller performs the normalization by computing Q(p) for each precoder and dividing each precoder by the square root of its corresponding quadratic form value__.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix T such that the resulting set of transformed precoders each satisfy the condition that Q(T·p_i) = Q(T·p_j) for all precoders p_i and p_j in the plurality of precoders __and such that each transformed precoder maps to antenna patterns having equal transmit power__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 18, wherein the transformation matrix is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array __and is computed such that T diagonalizes or normalizes the quadratic form across all precoders in the codebook__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array __by ensuring that the quadratic form Q(p) evaluated for each transformed precoder yields an identical value__.
